### Which @angular/* package(s) are the source of the bug?

core

### Is this a regression?

Yes

### Description

comments:
Hi, thanks for taking the time for providing a reproduction. 

I believe I have found the root cause and provided a fix in #54130

As Matthieu mentioned, the app should work correctly once PR https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/54130 lands. We are also working on an improvement for the `@defer` feature to resolve an issue described in #52876, which would allow using providers from NgModules imported in standalone components.
The root cause of this issue is #52876, so we'll close this as effectively a duplicate.
